name: shiftswifthr-mobile
description: Native iOS app for ShiftSwift HR (employee + business unified)

scripts.brand:ios:all: SSHR_APP=app npm run brand:ios && SSHR_APP=employee npm run brand:ios && SSHR_APP=business npm run brand:ios
scripts.ios:sync: node scripts/copy-www-app.mjs && SSHR_APP=app npx cap sync ios && SSHR_APP=app npm run brand:ios
scripts.ios:setup: npm run assets && npm run ios:add && npm run ios:sync && npm run brand:ios
scripts.ios:employee:sync: node scripts/copy-www-app.mjs && SSHR_APP=employee npx cap sync ios && SSHR_APP=employee npm run brand:ios
scripts.ios:business:sync: node scripts/copy-www-app.mjs && SSHR_APP=business npx cap sync ios && SSHR_APP=business npm run brand:ios
scripts.android:sync: node scripts/copy-www-app.mjs && SSHR_APP=app npx cap sync android
scripts.android:employee:sync: node scripts/copy-www-app.mjs && SSHR_APP=employee npx cap sync android
scripts.android:business:sync: node scripts/copy-www-app.mjs && SSHR_APP=business npx cap sync android
